title: Pursuit Positioning Lab
summary: A scenario-based sales practice experience that asks learners to evaluate opportunity evidence, judge solution fit and pursuit strength, and choose the next action.

content.business_need: Provide realistic practice for evaluating a sales opportunity using incomplete discovery evidence rather than simple recall.
content.audience: Sales learners practicing opportunity strategy and positioning judgment.
learning_objectives: Evaluate solution fit and pursuit strength.
Identify positioning risks and red flags.
content.role: Instructional design, scenario design, interaction design, copywriting, and front-end development.
content.design_approach: Use a fictional opportunity, customer evidence, scoring decisions, an expert benchmark, and targeted feedback to create practice before performance.
content.development_process: Built as a custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript interaction with fictionalized scenario data to demonstrate reusable sales-learning patterns without exposing proprietary content.
outcomes: Demonstrates evidence-based feedback and scoring logic.
Provides a reusable interaction pattern for future opportunity-practice scenarios.

source_material_notes: Public project uses fictional companies, products, customers, and opportunity data.
